notes: Each chunk is what one recv() returned, as byte values 0-255 (chunks may be empty); the connection closes after the last chunk. Return every complete message payload in order (each a list of byte values; zero-length messages are []), and if the stream ends partway through a header or payload, append one final None (null in Java). The 4-byte length is unsigned (up to 2^32 - 1), so read it into a long.
